description: List i18n keys. List keys for a profile, optionally filtered to a name `prefix`.

offset.description: Number of keys to skip before returning `limit` rows (offset pagination).

prefix.description: Only keys whose name starts with this.

profile_id.description: Profile id to list keys for.

q.description: Free-text search — matches keys whose name, value, OR description contains this substring (case-insensitive). Use it to find the key behind a piece of on-screen copy.

name: i18n_keys_list
